examples.ar: فَهِمَ الطُّلَّابُ الدَّرْسَ بَعْدَ تَفْصِيلِ المُعَلِّمِ.
examples.en: The students understood the lesson after the teacher's detailing.

examples.ar: الدَّوْلَةُ مَسْؤُولَةٌ عَنْ حِمَايَةِ المَوَارِدِ العَامَّةِ.
examples.en: The state is responsible for protecting public resources.

examples.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً.
examples.en: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.
Produce your proof, if you should be truthful.
Supplication is the believer's weapon in trials.

examples.ar: يَبْحَثُ النَّاسُ عَنْ دِفْءِ العَائِلَةِ فِي لَيَالِي الشِّتَاءِ.
examples.en: People seek the warmth of the family in winter nights.
